name: Witch Doctor Unstable Concoction heals allies within 20 yd of the marked target
contract: Unstable Concoction 802487: 'healing nearby allies within $802489a1 yds' (802489 EffectRadiusIndex 9 = 20
yd; 'Heals up to $i allies', MaxAffectedTargets 5). The class code casts 802489 on Allies(player, target,
AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:62-76), a script search with both object sizes (IsWithinDistInMap;
players 1.5 yd each) that keeps only friendly units in line of sight of the centre: 13 yd centre to centre
today, 23 yd under the tooltip (G-29 mechanism 3). Bracket (cycle 8 lead R3-e2, M-48): the marked target
is the Witch Doctor itself (Frog Bones 801663, Potion Toss 801661 at the doctor, then Loa's Brew 801670 at
the doctor, the class entry brew sequence), with grouped allies at 3 yd (control: healed in every build),
22.5 yd (0.5 yd inside the tooltip edge: healed only after a radius fix) and 23.5 yd (0.5 yd beyond: never).
Three allies and the doctor stay under the cap of 5. All four are race 1 at the Northshire creation point;
the line runs along +x, relocate keeps z, so the 3D distance equals the read 2D distance, and every unit
stays in grid cells a 10 or 20 yd search visits (cell edge at x = -8933.33). Potion Toss needs its
CasterAuraSpell 801702 (Has Ingredient Marker): Cauldron Brewer 92085 is learned first, so the real Frog
Bones gives the marker (SyncIngredients, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:38-45; brew_marker ok in final05)
and the scenario reads it instead of setting it. Line of sight from the doctor along the line is read by a
real Renew 25222 (RangeIndex 5 = 40 yd, no SPELL_ATTR2 ignore-LOS bit) at the far ally after the reads: the
edge ally stands on the same segment at the same height, so a landed Renew shows that the edge arm is not
lost to line of sight. A probable defect by code read; this scenario is its reproduction.
